title: Accounting and Tax Services for Forestry Companies

rows.before: We rebuild months or years of neglected books from bank deposits, log-buyer settlement statements and scaling tickets, so a forestry company that let its records slide through three cutting seasons gets a clean ledger instead of a $600,000 shoebox of paper.
rows.after: We rebuild months or years of neglected books from bank deposits, log-buyer settlement statements and scaling tickets, so a forestry company that let its records slide through three cutting seasons gets a clean ledger instead of a $600,000 shoebox of paper.
rows.note: $600,000 here is an illustrative dollar amount (not the small business limit); leave as is.

rows.before: We incorporated the company under the Ontario Business Corporations Act, moved the equipment and goodwill across on a section 85 rollover, applied the $500,000 Small Business Deduction so active income is taxed near 12.2%, and filed the outstanding T5018 slips.
rows.after: We incorporated the company under the Ontario Business Corporations Act, moved the equipment and goodwill across on a section 85 rollover, applied the $500,000 Small Business Deduction so active income is taxed near 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026), and filed the outstanding T5018 slips.
rows.note: Case-study result stated without a date as the current SBD-taxed rate; treated as current. If Sharad dates this engagement before July 1, 2026, switch to R3 (leave).

rows.before: Active income taxed near the 12.2% small-business rate
rows.after: Active income taxed near the 11.2% small-business rate
